guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation tables without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Lean on intrinsic sizing; .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto} for wide tables; overflow-wrap:anywhere for long unbreakable tokens (flag names, IDL); pre{overflow-x:auto} so code scrolls internally instead of widening the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied throughout: doc-tables inside .table-wrap, overflow-wrap:anywhere on h1/lede/inline code, pre with internal scroll, <wbr> in the member-page H1.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible data tables with proper headers caption
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use <caption> and <th scope=col|row> for data tables; don't use tables for layout; prefer native naming (figcaption, aria-label on note regions).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All data tables carry captions and scoped header cells; baseline banners use role=note with aria-label; enum/value tables use th scope=col.
